issues.explanation: preferred_fa «تحمل ریسک» is not printed in any INSO standard. The printed forms are «رواداری مخاطره» (INSO 23728 clause 7.3.2) and «سطح رواداری مخاطره» (INSO 23728 clause 8.1). Rule 1 requires the preferred Persian term to equal what the cited standard prints. Even in a 'printed-in-text-not-defined' situation, the INSO-printed form should take precedence over the book's NIST translation form.
issues.suggested_fix: Promote «رواداری مخاطره» to preferred_fa (as the shorter of the two printed forms). Move «تحمل ریسک» into alternatives_fa with a note that it is the form used in the book's NIST-translated passages. «سطح رواداری مخاطره» stays as an alternative (it is the clause 8.1 printed form).

issues.explanation: The INSO 23733 cover prints «مدیریت مخاطره (ریسک)» with the parenthetical gloss. The project normalisation policy (ii) states: 'a printed parenthetical gloss stays part of the headword and the form without the gloss is an alias.' The entry reverses this: it puts the glosless form «مدیریت مخاطره» as preferred and the printed-with-gloss form «مدیریت مخاطره (ریسک)» as an alternative.
issues.suggested_fix: Swap: preferred_fa → «مدیریت مخاطره (ریسک)» (the cover's printed form); move «مدیریت مخاطره» into alternatives_fa (the alias per normalisation policy, also attested in clause 4 heading).

issues.explanation: Minor: the evidence record omits the clause field (editor note cites clause 6.5.2 of INSO 23733). Adding the clause to the evidence would strengthen attribution. Not a blocking issue — the editor note compensates.
